title: Unary languages are contained in the all-ones language
statement: For every set $S$ of natural numbers, every Boolean string whose entries are all true and whose length belongs to $S$ is a string whose entries are all true; equivalently, the unary language determined by $S$ is contained in the all-ones language.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is an arbitrary set of natural numbers
